## Kindle Custom Screensaver v0.5.0

This release adds support for unlocking on Kindles with a device PIN enabled. It includes the fixes previously available in the `pin-fix-1` testing prerelease.

### Changes

* Shows the stock PIN dialog above the custom screensaver when unlocking begins
* Keeps the custom screensaver behind the PIN dialog so the book or menu stays covered until the PIN is validated
* Restores the book or menu after unlocking
* Avoids delayed refreshes after sleep by watching PIN-window stacking only when unlocking begins

### Installation and updates

Available through KPM or the `custom-screensaver-0.5.0-kindlehf.zip` release package.

For ZIP updates, disable the custom screensaver before replacing the runtime files, then re-enable it using the **Custom Screensaver** Scriptlet. Your screensaver images remain untouched.

Users of the `pin-fix-1` testing prerelease can update to this stable release. See the README for full installation and update instructions.
